mapper.select: SELECT g.garment_id, g.garment_no, g.garment_name, g.garment_type, g.unit_id, g.unit_name, g.remark, g.create_time FROM t_garment g WHERE g.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY g.garment_id DESC

SELECT g.garment_id, g.garment_no, g.garment_name, g.garment_type, g.unit_id, g.unit_name, g.remark, g.create_time FROM t_garment g
g.deleted_flag = 0
AND INSTR(g.garment_name, #{queryForm.garmentName})
AND INSTR(g.garment_no, #{queryForm.garmentNo})
ORDER BY g.garment_id DESC
